reviews.text:
So happy I came here Saturday with Sparkle
Kimberly at front desk was friendly & helpful
Geoff took vitals and information he was kind & reassuring he has worked here for 23 years!
Then sparkle and I saw the veterinarian Fai
She was thorough, knowledgeable, and patient. She gave us some good recommendations and sparkle, and I were very happy with our exam.
Thank you :)

Much Appreciated!
The care administered to my fur babies and myself. The senior discount and Saturday  vaccination discount are a blessing to  us all. Thankful! 🥰
Friendly effective place for pet owners to take their pet kids
Both assistants for my two cats were attentive and caring. The two different vets were also great.
We are always treated well at Alora.  Dr Khouban is the best. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend them.

I have been bringing my pets to Aloro for 13 years. I have been consistently satisfied with Aloro.  Vet staff, vet assistants and admin staff always professional and friendly. Also, of course,, good with the beloved pets!
Everyone is so nice and caring.

I have been coming to Aloro pet hospital for over 20 years.  Dr Dogra and his team were nothing short of excellent.  Sadly after his passing a new company has stepped in and care is not the same.  There is a high turn over rate with the vets. There is also an obvious push to upsell services - pushing X-rays, tests, etc when they are not needed.  The original staff at the front desk and the vet techs are wonderful.  I’m thankful they are still there.  But sadly I wouldn’t recommend services here anymore .  I get a new vet everytime I go who has to familiarize themselves with my dog and his health issues. Prices are through the roof. Aloro has lost the family atmosphere of care and trust that it had before.  It feels very corporate.  I hope it doesn’t go the way of private equity which is buying out all the vet clinics and retirement facilities.

I have been taking my pets to Alora Pet Clinic for 20 years. During that time I saw the beloved Dr. Dogra.

Since his untimely passing a few years ago, I have yet to find a doctor there with as much kindness and compassion as he had, until last week.

I had the pleasure of meeting Dr. Faye, and she was so fantastic. Kind, diligent, and highly intelligent. And finally found a great vet!

I got good advice about how and what to feed my dog from the technician who was a vet in his home country and is working towards certification here.  The staff was very friendly and informed.  The only reason I don’t give 5 stars is it’s expensive.  AI says one vaccine of three I got (for kennel cough) generally costs between $20-$40 and they charged $46 for it.

We’re in the area for the summer and took our Goldendoodle in for some stomach issues.  I was able to get a same day appointment, and I was so impressed with the care that my dog received from Dr.Fai.

She was so caring and thorough and clearly was thinking through all the potential causes of my dog’s issues.  It’s rare to have a vet take this much time to diagnose and investigate and I really appreciated the thoroughness.

Happy to have found this vet!

Amazing staff, all my pets needs were met above and beyond.  I just wish prices weren’t so high up for simple check ups.  I went in for flea meds and came out with a $400 bill.  Overall great staff and service

Dr. Fai was the right doctor for our 17 year rescue poodle mix. We were provided with multiple options and left with tips on how to monitor for heart murmurs. The doctor was very compassionate and sensitive to how we were concerned about our ailing family member.
Staff always nice and friendly.
Took a while but it was worth it the staff was great and the vets even better caring and informative I will definitely recommend Dr Fei and staff

Great, highly informed staff. I just switched for my dog so there was a female relief Vet there. She was great, compassionate, well versed and informative. My dog is very skittish, the visit went very well. Office staff very accommodating, office was very clean and well kept. I've heard good things about Dr. Khouban. I really like that that Aloro has not gone corporate and still has that Mom & Pop style facility. Prices are average for first visits in SoCal.
They are caring and knowledgeable. I have been going there for 30 years and my cats have all been well taken care of there.
I have been going to Aloro going on five dogs now over 15 years And I am always in capable, loving hands. From the doctors to the technicians to the front desk staff, Aloro delivers!
care for my dog
Love Aloro. Staff is great. Friendly, caring and good at what they do.
They took care of my baby Maurice and I like how fast and kind they were
waited for 2 hours for immunization shot, they even took a.person behind me

I absolutely LOVE Aloro  Pet Hospital! The staff is Great !! Compassionate, loving kind and funny ! My new adopted  puppy ,Ginger , a Mini- Poodle feels love and friendliness there as do I . Geoff , the technician,  is an absolutel caring and kind man. Ginger loves him, and Dr. Khouban and Bree . It's  a Godsend community  Hospital for pets !!
I just discovered Geoff from a friend's referral to help with my dog's impacted anal gland extraction..... I finally found someone who gets the job done well the first time!  Dr. Fai was great too.

Aloro pet clinic is the only clinic that helped my 13 yo cat and who could tell me the correct diagnosis, after a several vet clinic I visited,  who kept telling me that my cat is fine, Dr Khouban and Karen, finally diagnoses my cat, unfortunately with a cancer. Dr Khouban very thoughtful and kind doctor, she referenced me to an oncology vet clinic who were able to take me right away! Thank you Dr Khouban, Karen and entire Aloro pet clinic staff for your kindness! Ps my cat is doing better!

I cannot say enough wonderful things about our veterinarian, Dr Galleet Khouban and the care she has given to my dog, Roxy. Over the course of many health challenges, she has been not only incredibly knowledgeable, but also deeply compassionate and committed.
What truly sets her apart is the level of personal attention she provides. She consistently went above and beyond—taking the time to call and check in on Roxy, making sure she was improving, and adjusting care when needed. That kind of dedication is rare and meant so much to me during stressful times.
She also played a critical role in helping us navigate more complex issues by connecting us with the right specialists, ensuring Roxy received the best possible care every step of the way.
I am so grateful for her expertise, kindness, and genuine concern. Roxy is healthier and happier because of her, and I would wholeheartedly recommend her to anyone looking for a veterinarian who truly cares.

I’ve been coming to this facility for over a year, and I can confidently say they are incredibly helpful and provide prompt service from the front desk to the medical team.
Dr. Galleet Khouban has been a tremendous support to my family during one of the most difficult times—caring for our aging dogs. The level of attention, thoroughness, and consistent follow-up they provide for my fur baby is truly exceptional.
What stands out most is how genuinely caring and compassionate the entire team is. You can tell they truly care about both the pets and their families.
If I could give more stars, I absolutely would. Thank you so much to the Aloro Pet Hospital team and Dr. Khouban for your kindness and dedication.
Dr Khouban is wonderful bc she cares for my puppy, Fifi, (toy poodle) and coaches me. (First time with a pup). The office staff (yeah, Kimberly) are supportive too!

I have been going to Aloro for about six years now and love this place. The staff is always very professional and empathetic. I have a hard time trusting people with my animals but I have to say Dr. Khouban is the best she is very caring and compassionate. I love that she makes herself available to talk if there are any that issues arise. I definitely recommend Aloro Pet Hospital.

I can hardly express how grateful we are for Dr. Khoubin. We showed up last week with our dog in severe distress in a seizure storm and thanks to Dr. khoubin, he’s properly medicated and is back home living out his golden days comfortable and happy. Dr Khoubin has called us every single day (even on weekends/days off) to check on his progress and listen to our fears and questions.
Kind and knowledgeable staff and plenty of parking! Woopwoop.

The front desk staff can be a little hit or miss, but Dr. Galleet Khouban is the reason we come here. She’s very thorough, compassionate, and takes the time to explain everything clearly. I always feel like my dog is in good hands with her and that she truly cares about the animals she treats. I probably wouldn’t come back otherwise.

I have very mixed feelings about this visit. Overall, I cannot recommend this place in full confidence, especially if you have a greyhound.
I took my greyhound in for the first time since she had some mysterious discharge in one eye and I could not get her in to see her regular vet soon enough. She was already on OTC drops that seemed to be improving her eye. But I took her in to ensure everything checked out.
While we waited for the vet, she was pacing in a panic.
When the Dr. Khouban entered, my dog excitedly greeted her, as she loves people. The vet then, oddly, asked if my dog was friendly before interacting with her any further.
The vet was personable towards me, but seemed impatient and lacked compassion towards my dog, who was clearly in distress, still pacing and panting. She made these loud whistle noises to get my dog’s attention. I understand she needed to look at her eye, but her behavior towards my dog came across as cold. And my dog was just trying to find a way out of the room.
For context: My girl’s regular vet once sat and allowed my girl to rest her head on her lap as she stroked her, as my dog was in distress at her last visit there. Seeing the stark contrast between this vet and her regular vet was unsettling.
The vet explained the tests she might do, and what would determine if each test was needed. And then which medication would be required based on the test results. She said she didn’t see any signs of glaucoma. Contrary to what she explained to me, she ended up doing all 3 eye tests, including the one for glaucoma, and gave my girl antibiotic drops with a steroid, even though all the tests were negative. And the steroid medication was for the worst problem, to my understanding. When I questioned why she needed a steroid, the vet said it would help with the inflammation in her eye. She then pulled back my girl’s eyelids to show the difference in inflammation in the veins between each eye. The manner in which she did it felt cold.

She explained that she would need to wear a cone and take the eye drops for at least 7 days. As a note, as I said, her eye was already improving when we got there. So much so that the vet didn’t initially notice anything wrong with her eye. But now here she was prescribing this intense treatment.
I didn’t get the second guy’s name who helped with the tests, but he got a cone for her and tried to fit it over my girl’s neck. It was falling off her narrow neck. Despite this, the vet said it needed to be larger (in diameter) because her legs are long and she could still reach her eye with the cone he initially brought . She explained the danger of her scratching her eye while using the steroid, and that it could lead to further problems (which is why I questioned the need for the steroid in the first place. It seemed like overkill, especially since she explained that the drops could be irritating, which would lead to my dog wanting to scratch her eye. By this point she was not scratching it).
He didn’t get a larger one, and instead, got something to tie the smaller one with. I was happy he did that, as he seemed to be looking out for my girl.
My girl tried to walk out of the clinic again. He kindly offered to hold her while I went to pay. The woman who checked me out was also kind.
However, the label on the medication she gave me was written for the drops to be applied to both eyes. I understand that may be how it auto-populates in the system, but the fact that I caught it and had to ask for it to be confirmed with vet and corrected, only added to the list of issues during this visit.
Chris was helpful in providing an estimate over the phone before the visit, the front desk staff was friendly, and the guy who weighed my dog was pleasant. Dr. Khouban seems to be better with people than dogs, however. And I wouldn’t trust her to treat my dog again.
On a positive note, She did call to check on my dog the next day.
Thanks for your review!

I want to love this place as I’ve been going here for over a year and I like Dr. Chen, but the front desk staff single-handily make it an unwelcoming experience. The last time I was there the two women at the front desk had a small conversation in front of me, arguing about who should help me. “Okay you handle it–“ “What? Why me? Ugh fine,” and then finally turned to acknowledge me, saying hello in a fake cheerful voice. I was literally standing right in front of them and said, “You know I can hear you, right?” It was so odd and very poor customer care. Their staff need serious training.

I just love Aloro Pet Clinic. The staff is very kind and always takes good care of me and Zoey.
Dr. Khouban is so kind and patient. She takes the time to make sure I understand everything.  She takes a great care of Zoey and I feel lucky she is  Zoey's doctor.
Now that the staff is in place, Aloro is back to being the go-to vet in the Studio City area.  Thank you!!
The Best Pet Clinic in the SFV 🤗 they have provided the Best Care & Services for All My Families Pets for years! Thanks for the Great Care & Services!

I have been going to Aloro for many years now and  I have to say, there were several times in the last few years that I almost switched vets. I'm glad I didnt because Dr. Chen is AMAZING.  My 7 year old Chihuahu got diagnosed with a liver tumor and she needed to have surgery at a different place with a specialist. But Dr. Chen (who first diagnosed the tumor) was compassionate,  caring and extremely knowledgeable.  She is amazing with follow-up calls after a visit and was extremely helpful when I had questions regarding the surgery that was being handled at a different place. She even called to check up on our dog after the surgery to make sure our pup was doing ok.  Again, Dr. Chen is truly amazing!.
Love this place. Take care of my puppy. The Dr....she is amazingly caring, helpful and take time to explain everything to a new mommy.

I’ve been going to Aloro Pet Hospital for about 10 years. The staff has always been kind and professional. My late chihuahua needed a lot of care and he always returned calmer than when I brought him in. I appreciate the Drs calling and asking how my pups have been doing after a visit. Top notch 🤌🐺

Wow. This is a hard goodbye, but it is time. I have been coming to Aloro since 2007 and have always appreciated their front office staff, their operations, and their amazing doctors. I have trusted my babies in their hands for many years.

Fast forward to 2025. I am moving on to a different veterinarian. I recently needed vaccinations for my babies and was told one thing over the phone to get me to bring one of them into the clinic for her shots, even though I could have saved money by taking her to the doctor currently overseeing her care. Needless to say, the story changed when I arrived.

Their employees offered a deal that was not honored in person. The explanation I received was that the staff member "meant 10 percent instead of 50 percent." As a math major, that was absurd to me. The difference between 10 percent off and 50 percent off, especially for a service my baby did not need because she is under another doctor's care, is huge.

Not to mention the care my other baby received this summer. She was sent away with no medical care because of her anxiety, which forced me to take her to another clinic that treated her right away even with her anxiety. This ultimately saved her life. I did not complain then because I wanted to give Aloro a chance since management had just changed.

Today we received care from a truly kind and amazing doctor, Dr. Chen, but because of the operational issues, we have no choice but to find a different veterinarian.

Thank you Dr. Dogra(RIP), Dr. Anush, and prior management and office techs for years of awesome service and care. And to the current Aloro tech who can deal with my fearful baby, you rock.
The staff is great and I have never had to wait longer than 10 min (if I have an appt).  The Staff are caring and informative.  I have taken our dogs there for over 20 years.

We’ve been clients of Aloro for decades.  Literally 4. Dr. Suresh Dogra was the heart, soul, and guiding wisdom behind Aloro’s success for most of that time. His passing 2 years ago left a huge gap… but now, I’m so happy, relieved and grateful to report, they’ve found a first rate team.
The staff (Karla, Kimberly, Juan Carlos, & Geoff) have been extraordinary through it all.  Now Dr. Khouban & Dr. Chen are heading the medical supervision.  We’ve seen them both and have been so impressed with their compassion, commitment, and expertise.

After a long search, the excellence is back!
Thank you!!
I am so happy I found this place to take care of my new puppy.

Had a great experience on my last visit   The staff and new vets are wonderful. Aloro Pet Clinic is a great place to take your pets in 2025. . I’ve been a customer since 2018. I’ve been through the different ownerships/management over the years. I would recommend.

I had a great experience this week at Aloro Pet Hospital. My 2 1/2 year old Husky had an infected oval spot on her muzzle. It may have been caused three different causes, with two requiring expensive tests to be certain. Dr. Kuban suggested we try the least expensive solution first (which appears to be working!). My total bill was 10% of what it might have been, and I really appreciated the 50% off first time patient discount. Dr. Kuban and the staff were all warm and friendly, I’ll definitely return the next time our dogs need medical attention.

Dr. Khouban went above and beyond to help Freddie with a few issues. She really cares, and always calls to follow up on his progress. The effort and energy provided is really appreciated. Visiting vets usually really sucks, but it sucks less when people care.

This morning I called regarding my cat. They told me to come there in 20 mins and took care of me right away when I got there. Very friendly and did not try to upsell me on test and vaccines like ALL of the other vets I’ve been to in the past. Gave a new customer discount and treated my cat within an hour. My cat hates me now but the vet was a Great experience!

had a great experience at Aloro Pet Hospital. Dr. Chen was absolutely lovely with my kitten. She handled her gently, made the visit feel stressfree, and clearly cares about her patients. The staff were friendly and efficient, and the clinic felt clean and welcoming. I left feeling confident that my kitten was in excellent hands. Highly recommend Dr. Chen and Aloro Pet Hospital for anyone looking for compassionate, professional care for their pets.

This new staff/owner is great.  My Buddy has been coming to Aloro vet clinic since 2013, months after rescuing him from a kill shelter at about 3-4 yrs. old.  I have seen this clinic go through a few different owners/staff after the original owner/vet passed away a few years ago.  The new owner/manager of this clinic seems to be highly in control/organized and very friendly.  There are 2 young vets my dog saw in Sept and Oct. this year.  The energy now with this new staff feels more relaxing as opposed to chaotic and noisy.  Last month, Oct. 20th, I had no choice left but to bring my Buddy in for his final visit of being put down in my arms while I rocked him and sang to him the song I always did - "You are so beautiful". Just after turning 16 yrs. old the month before, he just could not hold on anymore.  The staff was so supportive, kind and very knowledgeable. The vet who put my Buddy down was putting her own dog down 2 days later after my final visit.  I brought her a card the day after she had to do it.  I ran into her out in the back parking lot of the clinic where I normally park, got out of my car and we just hugged and cried.  She said to me: 'you have no idea how badly I need this hug, but yet I have to remain professional in there'.  Im glad I could be there for her in return.  I picked up Buddys' ashes from them last weekend.  Around that time, I received a card from them.  They all signed it underneath the kind message they each wrote to me in the card.  I fell apart from this heartfelt gesture.   Yes, vet bills are more expensive no matter were an owner goes these days.  I did research on this, by going on YouTube. There are many vets, with their own channels to learn from and it was explained to me.  Many things are now expensive including this.  But I would recommend any dog/cat owner to this clinic.  They are a brand new lovely group of people and respectful.  It was special to me that they could be present with my very old dog and me for his final visit and goodbye to all of us.  I will long remember this day.  God bless you all in Aloro Vet Clinic.  Buddy is now again with his grandpa, my dad who I just buried January this year.  He is once again 'emotional support dog' to my dad....in heaven💕& internal PEACE.❤️
